summary: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: HALO) filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, announcing the pricing of an upsized private offering of $1.3 billion aggregate principal amount of 1.50% convertible senior notes due 2033, increased from $1.05 billion. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, offered to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, with a 13-day option for up to an additional $200 million. Initial conversion rate is 7.1509 shares per $1,000 principal. No board recommendation or advisor is named; proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes, potentially including capital returns. Watch for dilution risk and market reaction.
